Selection Controls

Custom-styled native checkbox and radio inputs. The same markup and the same CSS render correctly in both themes — the right-hand pane only adds data-theme="dark". Every state is shown: unchecked, checked, hover, focus, disabled, and error.

data-theme="light"

Checkbox — all states

Notifications Choose how the district contacts you.

Radio group — error state

Preferred campus

Error: Select a campus to continue.

data-theme="dark"

Checkbox — all states

Notifications Choose how the district contacts you.

Radio group — error state

Preferred campus

Error: Select a campus to continue.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Checkbox: native input + clickable label -->
<div class="hisd-selection-controls">
  <fieldset class="hisd-selection-controls__group">
    <legend class="hisd-selection-controls__legend">Notifications</legend>
    <div class="hisd-selection-controls__list">
      <label class="hisd-selection-controls__option">
        <input class="hisd-selection-controls__input hisd-selection-controls__input--checkbox"
               type="checkbox" name="notify" value="email">
        <span class="hisd-selection-controls__text">Email</span>
      </label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
</div>

<!-- Radio group: fieldset/legend, role="radiogroup", error via aria-invalid -->
<div class="hisd-selection-controls">
  <fieldset class="hisd-selection-controls__group" role="radiogroup"
            aria-describedby="campus-err">
    <legend class="hisd-selection-controls__legend">Preferred campus</legend>
    <div class="hisd-selection-controls__list">
      <label class="hisd-selection-controls__option">
        <input class="hisd-selection-controls__input hisd-selection-controls__input--radio"
               type="radio" name="campus" value="austin">
        <span class="hisd-selection-controls__text">Austin High School</span>
      </label>
      <label class="hisd-selection-controls__option">
        <input class="hisd-selection-controls__input hisd-selection-controls__input--radio"
               type="radio" name="campus" value="lamar">
        <span class="hisd-selection-controls__text">Lamar High School</span>
      </label>
    </div>
    <p class="hisd-selection-controls__error" id="campus-err">
      <span class="sr-only">Error:</span> Select a campus to continue.
    </p>
  </fieldset>
</div>
